mapper.select: /** * searchComboBoxAprv : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.TlcmtChgReqstdMngMapper : 승인상태구분코드 조회 */ SELECT AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS CD_VALUE , AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS CD_NAME FROM SAC100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'APRV_STTS_SE_CD' AND AA.CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN ('0','2','3')

/** * selectTlcmtChgReqstdMngDetail : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.TlcmtChgReqstdMngMapper : 재택근무지변경신청 상세조회 */ SELECT ( SELECT A1.DEPT_NM FROM SAA300 A1 WHERE 1=1 AND A1.DEPT_CD = CC.OGDP_DEPT_CD ) AS OGDP_INST_NM /* 소속기관명 */ , '직급' AS JBGD_NM /* 직급명 */ , CC.ENFSN_NO AS ENFSN_NO /* 종사자 번호 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(CC.FLNM_ENCPT) AS CNSLTNT_NM /* 상담사명 */ , TO_CHAR(AA.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REG_YMD /* 작성일 */ , CC.WRD_TELNO AS WRD_TELNO /* 유선전화번호 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(CC.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO /* 무선전화번호 */ , AA.CNSLTNT_ID AS APLCNT_ID /* 신청자 아이디 */ , AA.HMTRC_WORK_CS_CN AS HMTRC_WORK_CS_CN /* 재택근무사유내용 */ , AA.ZIP AS ZIP /* 우편번호 */ , AA.TRPR_ADDR AS TRPR_ADDR /* 신규주소 */ , AA.TRPR_LCTN_DADDR AS TRPR_LCTN_DADDR /* 신규주소1 */ , AA.HMTRC_WORK_CHG_YMD AS HMTRC_WORK_CHG_YMD /* 신청일(재택근무변경일자) */ , AA.APRV_STTS_SE_CD AS APRV_STTS_SE_CD /* 승인상태구분코드 */ , AA.RJCT_CS_CN AS RJCT_CS_CN /* 반려사유 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(CC.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO_ENCPT /* 유선전화번호 */ FROM AYC340 AA , SAA200 BB , SCA100 CC WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CNSLTNT_ID = BB.USER_ID AND BB.ENFSN_NO = CC.ENFSN_NO
AND AA.INDEX_SN = #{indexSn}
mapper.update: /** * deleteTlcmtChgReqstdMng : isry.couns.mngr.atrzmng.mapper.TlcmtChgReqstdMngMapper : 재택근무지변경신청 삭제 */ UPDATE AYC340 AA /** 재택근무지 변경 **/ SET AA.DEL_YN = 'Y' , AA.LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE , AA.LAST_MDFR_ID = #{loginId} WHERE 1=1 AND AA.INDEX_SN = #{indexSn}
